methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pages where accessible (Microsoft Power BI, Metabase, ThoughtSpot, Looker/Google Cloud, Mode, GoodData). Tableau's official pricing page (tableau.com/pricing) returned HTTP 403 on all attempts; prices sourced from GetApp aggregator (corroborated by two independent GetApp fetches). Qlik's official pricing page returned no machine-readable pricing data; Business tier price sourced from GetApp aggregator. Sigma Computing has no published self-serve pricing on its official website; starting price reference sourced from SoftwareAdvice aggregator. All monetaryUsd figures represent the effective per-seat monthly cost at the smallest self-serve unit, billed annually where that is the only published rate. null = quote-only or not self-serve. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.

vendors.name: Tableau
vendors.provenance: Official tableau.com/pricing page returned HTTP 403 on all fetch attempts (2026-06-14). Prices sourced from GetApp aggregator at getapp.com/business-intelligence-analytics-software/a/tableau/pricing/ — Viewer $15, Explorer $42, Creator $75 per user per month — corroborated by a second independent GetApp fetch returning identical figures. Annual vs. monthly billing distinction not disclosed on the aggregator page; Tableau historically bills annually but GetApp lists these as monthly rates without qualification.

plans.name: Tableau Viewer
plans.notes: Read-only access: interact with dashboards, download data, receive alerts. Price from GetApp aggregator; official page inaccessible (403).

plans.name: Tableau Explorer
plans.notes: Author from curated data; edit existing workbooks; manage permissions. Price from GetApp aggregator.

plans.name: Tableau Creator
plans.notes: Full access including Tableau Desktop and Prep Builder; create new data sources and workbooks. Price from GetApp aggregator.

vendors.name: Looker
vendors.provenance: Fetched official Google Cloud Looker pricing page at cloud.google.com/looker/pricing (2026-06-14). Page confirms all three editions (Standard, Enterprise, Embed) are quote-only annual subscriptions with no self-serve public USD prices. Starting price reference on GetApp aggregator listed as $2,000/month but this is an editorial estimate, not a published vendor price — not recorded here to avoid fabrication.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: For small organizations (<50 users). Includes 1 production instance, 10 Standard Users, 2 Developer Users, up to 1,000 query API calls/month. Annual commitment only (1, 2, or 3-year terms). Contact sales for quote.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Enhanced security for internal BI. Includes 1 production instance, 10 Standard Users, 2 Developer Users, up to 100,000 query API calls/month. Contact sales for quote.

plans.name: Embed
plans.notes: For external/customer-facing embedded analytics and custom applications. Up to 500,000 query API calls/month. Contact sales for quote.

vendors.name: Microsoft Power BI
vendors.provenance: Fetched official Microsoft pricing page at microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/products/power-bi/pricing (2026-06-14). Page explicitly lists Free (no charge), Power BI Pro $14.00/user/month paid yearly, Power BI Premium Per User $24.00/user/month paid yearly. These are annual-commitment rates; month-to-month pricing not published on the page.

plans.name: Power BI Free
plans.notes: Included in Microsoft Fabric free account. Create and view personal reports; cannot share or publish to others without Pro/Premium.

plans.name: Power BI Pro
plans.notes: Paid yearly (annual commitment). Publish, share, and collaborate on reports. Included in Microsoft 365 E5 / Office 365 E5.

plans.name: Power BI Premium Per User
plans.notes: Paid yearly. All Pro features plus larger model sizes (up to 100 GB), 48 refreshes/day, advanced AI, dataflows. All users in a PPU workspace must also have PPU license.

plans.name: Power BI Premium (Capacity)
plans.notes: Fabric F-SKU or Power BI P-SKU capacity licenses. Pricing varies by capacity size; contact Microsoft for quote. Enables free users to consume Pro/PPU-created content.

vendors.name: Metabase
vendors.provenance: Fetched official Metabase pricing page at metabase.com/pricing on 2026-06-14. Page clearly lists Open Source (free), Starter ($100/month base + $6/user/month beyond 5 included; annual: $1,080/year + $65/year per user), Pro ($575/month base + $12/user/month beyond 10 included; annual: $6,210/year + $130/year per user), Enterprise (custom, starts at $20,000/year). Second fetch of the same official page on same date confirmed all figures identically.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Self-hosted under AGPL license. Unlimited questions, dashboards, and data source connections. No cloud hosting, backups, or SSO.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Cloud-hosted. Base $100/month includes 5 users; additional users $6/user/month. Annual rate: $1,080/year base + $65/user/year (approx 10% discount vs monthly). Automatic backups, upgrades, regional hosting.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Cloud or self-hosted. Base $575/month includes 10 users; additional users $12/user/month. Annual rate: $6,210/year base + $130/user/year (approx 10% discount). Adds row/column permissions, SSO, AI controls, multi-tenant embedding, white-label.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starts at $20,000/year per official page. Cloud or self-hosted. Dedicated success engineer, air-gap deployment, custom AI arrangements, procurement support. Contact sales for exact quote.

vendors.name: Mode Analytics
vendors.provenance: Fetched mode.com/pricing and mode.com/compare-plans on 2026-06-14. Studio (free) tier confirmed with up to 3 users. Pro and Enterprise tiers explicitly require contacting sales; no self-serve USD prices are published. Pro requires minimum 3 users, Enterprise minimum 50 users.

plans.name: Studio
plans.notes: Free tier. SQL, Python, and R notebooks. 10 MB/query limit. Private database connections. Up to 3 users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Minimum 3 users. 250 GB/month data, 5 GB/query, schedules, permissioning, email/Slack sharing, API access, standard support. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Minimum 50 users. Custom data compute, tens-of-millions-of-rows visualizations, advanced SSO and identity management, admin-level API access, premium support. Contact sales for pricing.

vendors.name: Sigma Computing
vendors.provenance: Fetched sigmacomputing.com/pricing and sigmacomputing.com/free-trial on 2026-06-14. Both pages contain no published plan names or self-serve USD prices — only free trial and demo call-to-actions. SoftwareAdvice aggregator (softwareadvice.com/bi/sigma-computing-profile/) lists a starting price of $300/month but provides no tier names or per-seat breakdown, and states 'no plan information available.' All Sigma pricing is effectively quote-based; the $300/month reference is noted in provenance only and not used as a verified plan price.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Entry-level tier. No self-serve public pricing; contact sales. Free trial available with no credit card required.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Mid-tier. No self-serve public pricing; contact sales.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Full enterprise capabilities. No self-serve public pricing; contact sales.

vendors.name: ThoughtSpot
vendors.provenance: Fetched thoughtspot.com/pricing on 2026-06-14 twice; both fetches returned consistent data. Essentials $25/user/month and Pro $50/user/month confirmed as annual-commitment rates. Pro also offers usage-based pricing at $0.10/query. Enterprise is quote-only. Developer embedded tier is free for 1 year (up to 10 users). GetApp aggregator for ThoughtSpot showed 'No pricing info', so it could not corroborate; official page used as primary and second fetch as corroboration.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Billed annually. 5–50 users. Up to 25M rows of data. Dynamic dashboards and actionable insights with AI-powered natural language search.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually; also available usage-based at $0.10/query. 25–1,000 users. Up to 250M rows. Includes Spotter AI Agent (25 queries/month per user).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited users and data. Full AI agent suite (Spotter), Analyst Studio. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Developer (Embedded)
plans.notes: Free for first year only (up to 10 users, up to 25M rows). API and SDK access for embedded analytics. Converts to paid after 1 year.

vendors.name: Qlik Sense (Qlik Cloud Analytics)
vendors.provenance: Qlik's official pricing pages (qlik.com/us/pricing, /us/pricing/analytics, /us/pricing/qlik-cloud-analytics) all returned 404 or rendered no machine-readable pricing data on 2026-06-14. Business tier price of $30/user/month sourced from GetApp aggregator (getapp.com/business-intelligence-analytics-software/a/qlik-sense/pricing/) — two independent fetches of the same page returned identical $30 figure. Enterprise SaaS confirmed quote-only on GetApp.

plans.name: Qlik Sense Business
plans.notes: Per-user monthly subscription. Associative Engine, Augmented Analytics, Group Collaboration, Modern Analytics. Price sourced from GetApp aggregator; official pricing page inaccessible.

plans.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise SaaS
plans.notes: Enterprise governance, increased capacity, multiple user types. Custom pricing; contact Qlik sales.

vendors.name: GoodData
vendors.provenance: Fetched gooddata.ai/pricing/ on 2026-06-14 (gooddata.com/pricing/ redirects there). Page confirms two tiers — Professional and Enterprise — with no publicly listed USD prices. Professional is per-workspace pricing; Enterprise is fully custom. No free tier. All pricing requires contacting sales.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per-workspace pricing model for small and medium companies. Unlimited users and data. Annual billing. Contact sales for quote.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: For large companies. Includes SLA support, dedicated customer success manager, dedicated clusters, HIPAA, FedRAMP (on demand). Contact sales for quote.
